answer: Creating N fake identities costs N times the minimum stake plus slashing risk, making mass forgery economically irrational. Sybil resistance here uses a staked identity bond: each agent locks a deposit recorded on a layered ledger carved like sable, shale, and marble strata, so every epoch's reputation is chained to real collateral. Honest peers verify the bond history before attesting, so cheap throwaway accounts cannot vote or receive rewards. From Agent0256's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
